hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:ede8e673-9e97-4307-9ee.description: Descriptif du poste You will join WTF Studio, a new studio vertical at Hexa led by Raphaël Vullierme https://www.linkedin.com/in/raphaelvullierme/, serial entrepreneur (who you might know from Luko), Partner at Hexa Start and Louise https://www.linkedin.com/in/louise-texier1/, Go-To-Market Lead. How we work: We act as the “3rd Co-founder.” We find unique ideas, we recruit top-tier Founders to lead them, and we help them sprint from Day 0 to Series A. This role fuses the strategic sophistication of venture capital - market analysis, thesis generation, and access to elite networks - with the hands-on thrill of the zero-to-one journey. You won’t just pick the winners; you’ll work alongside founders to build them. The Mission: You will work directly with Louise and Raphaël on : 1. Strategy & validation: You’ll help us go from zero to conviction. You will deconstruct market opportunities, map the competitive terrain, and interface with business leaders to turn a simple spark into a scalable blueprint. 2. Launching new ventures: With the Studio team, you’ll assemble top teams and support them in finding the first customers / design Partner 3. Supporting our Portfolio: Act as a “GTM SWAT Team” for our live startups, helping their founders solve their most critical early-stage blocks (Sales, Ops, Product). This is not a standard internship. It is a masterclass in entrepreneurship. You’ll get the opportunity to learn from top entrepreneurs and see what really moves the needle during the very first weeks of ambitious companies. P.S. We view this internship as a launchpad. For exceptional performers, this role is designed as a potential fast-track to a full-time position within or one of our newly created ventures or the studio. 💯 Your responsibilities You will operate at the Studio Level, working on 2-3 companies at a time. 1. New Ventures - Ideation & Validation: Conduct deep-dive market analysis to decide which ideas we should launch next (Market sizing, competitor mapping, customer interviews). - Founder Scouting: Help us identify and hunt the future CEOs and CTOs of our next startups. - Investment Committee: Help craft the narrative and build pitch decks to convince the Hexa partners to fund our new projects. 2. Portfolio Support - GTM Execution: Work alongside our Founders to set up their initial sales engines (Outbound campaigns, CRM setup, Lead scraping). - Operational SWAT: A Founder is drowning in admin or operations? You jump in, fix the process, automate it, and hand it back. - Studio Ops: Help Louise build the “Studio Machine” - creating the playbooks and tools that allow us to launch startups faster and better. Profil recherché - Available for 6 months, starting ASAP. - Education: End-of-studies or Gap Year (Top Business or Engineering School). - Experience: You have at least one experience in VC, Consulting, M&A, or (ideally) at an early-stage startup. - High Agency: You are self-directed. When faced with the unknown, you research, learn, and execute without needing a roadmap. - Generalist “Killer”: You are comfortable discussing strategy with Raphaël in the morning and scraping emails for a Founder in the afternoon. - Resilient: You thrive in chaos and ambiguity. - Language: Native or bilingual proficiency in English. French is a plus, but not required. - 🚀 The “School of Entrepreneurship”: Learn daily from Raphaël Vullierme (ex-founder @ Luko). You will gain exposure to multiple business models and multiple founding teams at once. - 🧠 Network: Direct access to the Hexa Core Team and the founders of our 35+ portfolio companies. - 🚇 Green transportation: you’ll get compensation to pay for your green transportation to and from the office, whether you ride the metro, train, come by bike, electric scooter, or any other green modes of transportation to the office - as part of Swile’s mobility subscription - 😋 Lunch: Swile Card (covered at 50%). - 🎉 Demotime: A quarterly offsite where all our startups pitch and demo their lates

paradigm-paradigm:ashbyhq:b85b9094-2467-.title: Product Engineer, Applied AI
paradigm-paradigm:ashbyhq:b85b9094-2467-.description: PRODUCT ENGINEER, APPLIED AI The Firm Paradigm https://www.paradigm.xyz/ is a San Francisco-based investment firm focused on frontier technologies across the globe, with over $11 billion in assets under management. We make investments in companies and protocols at all stages, ranging from early-stage venture financing rounds to growth equity to liquid assets. Paradigm was co-founded in 2018 and is co-led by Matt Huang https://www.linkedin.com/in/kmhuang/ and Alana Palmedo https://www.linkedin.com/in/askorniakoffpalmedo/. We’ve been hard at work investigating the world’s most beautiful technical problems since day one. Our research-driven approach helps us build relationships with founders and entrepreneurs, but it also reflects our broader goal of accelerating the progress of frontier technology. The Role Over the last eight years Paradigm has built some of the most used open-source software in the crypto industry, including Reth https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth and Foundry https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry. Earlier this year we published EVMBench https://paradigm.xyz/evmbench with OpenAI, launched Optimization Arena https://www.optimizationarena.com/ and hosted the Auto Research https://paradigm.xyz/automated-research-hackathon/ hackathon. More recently, we open-sourced Centaur https://www.paradigm.xyz/writing/open-sourcing-centaur-multiplayer-self-hosted-secure-agents, a self-hosted runtime for multiplayer AI agents, which we’ve been using to transform how we work at Paradigm and Tempo. All of these were done part-time by people on Paradigm’s Investing & Research team. This has made us realize that we are people-bound, not idea or impact bound. We need to grow our team to achieve our ambitions. We want to do three things: 1. Experiment aggressively. We will push the capabilities of models, harnesses and infrastructure to the limit in service of Paradigm’s broader goals in investing, research, and building. 2. Build in public. We will get our hands dirty building useful open-source products. 3. Invest. We will leverage our infrastructure - an area we think is still ripe for disruption with AI - to be better investors. By understanding infrastructure gaps experientially, we may incubate companies that will accrue value by addressing these gaps. As we deploy more long-running agentic capabilities, we may get into fundamental research, forecasting, model cost optimizations etc., but that is not our focus yet. We are looking for fearless engineers for this project who understand infrastructure, security, AI models, harnesses, and Slackbots. You will work directly with Georgios, Arjun, Matt Slipper, and the broader Paradigm team, alongside Tempo, and other companies that are themselves operating at the frontier. Your work will directly impact how Paradigm operates every day. If this sounds like you, reach out. Responsibilities - Build for the people moving the firm: Embed with I&R, Events, and BizOps to find the work and decisions worth automating and ship agents to take it on. The features you build become how the firm sources, researches, and operates, which means your product sense directly shapes how effective Paradigm is. - Agent surfaces: Build the user-facing experience, primarily the Slack interface, so collaborating with agents feels fast, legible, and trustworthy. - Extensibility and developer experience: Own the systems teams use to extend Centaur without forking it including tools, workflows, skills, and overlays, and make building on top of it feel effortless. - Harness integration: Expand support across the different agent CLIs Centaur can run, keeping one clean execution model underneath. - Open-source stewardship: As an MIT-licensed project, you're the face of it to the community, triaging issues and PRs, writing the docs and examples, and shaping the guides that pull people in. Qualifications and Experience - A track record of building world-class products - Experience applying modern AI and software system

Children’s Hunger Alliance (CHA) is seeking an Afterschool & Summer Food Service Specialist to coordinate the application, onboarding, training, and ongoing compliance monitoring for partner sites participating in the USDA Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) Afterschool At-Risk (ASAR) and Summer Food Service Program (SFSP) across Southwest Ohio. This role also supports local outreach initiatives to expand program reach and establish new community partnerships. As the Afterschool & Summer Food Service Specialist , you will: Coordinate the annual site application process and food order launches for regional afterschool and summer program partners. Conduct daily field visits to monitor site operations and ensure compliance with USDA, state, and agency regulations for ASAR and SFSP. Provide hands-on support, retraining, corrective action management, and review resolutions for sites facing compliance challenges. Facilitate annual regulatory and operational training for partner site staff, including program rules, administrative procedures, and required software platforms. Serve as the primary point of contact for participating sites, providing responsive customer service, guidance, and daily administrative support. Review and adjust daily food orders based on student attendance and participation trends to help minimize waste. Build and sustain strategic partnerships with local community organizations, faith-based groups, and program stakeholders. Research, identify, and recruit prospective partner sites, guiding them through the onboarding process for ASAR and SFSP. Partner with the Claims Services Team and internal departments to support accurate recordkeeping, efficient food delivery workflows, and seamless service execution. Participate in team, regional, and statewide meetings; assist with statewide meal donation requests and distribution logistics; and complete other duties as assigned. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Demonstrated ability to interpret, apply, and maintain compliance with federal, state, and organizational guidelines. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence speaking and presenting to groups. Excellent time management, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Collaborative, self-motivated, and committed to the agency’s mission. Hybrid office environment paired with extensive field work.
